messages.content: You help flood rescue teams read residents' clips.

content.text: A resident filmed this clip in a flooded street. Estimate the water depth range in metres where people and vehicles are, and say whether the water flows. Describe in one sentence what happens, in English (what_happens_en) and in Spanish (what_happens_local). Transcribe anything said on the audio in its own language (speech) and translate it to English (speech_en); both empty if nothing is said.

response.content: {"depth_m": {"high": 0.6, "low": 0.3}, "speech": "", "speech_en": "", "water_flow": "fast", "what_happens_en": "A residential street is heavily flooded with muddy water reaching the lower doors and bumpers of parked cars.", "what_happens_local": "Una calle residencial est\u00e1 gravemente inundada con agua turbia que llega hasta las puertas bajas y los parachoques de los coches aparcados."}
